segments.en: Today we have a luxury guest who comes to talk to us about how AI is experienced within a giant in the world of technology, which has been a pioneer in many AI processes due to its great vision and importance in today's world. We are talking about nothing more and nothing less than Google and today we are joined by Pablo Samuel Castro who is a Research Software Developer at Google.

segments.source: Pablo Samuel Castro comparte su experiencia como desarrollador de software de investigación en Google en el momento de esta entrevista. Nos cuenta cómo llegó a la IA, en qué proyectos ha colaborado y qué retos encuentra la investigación aplicada. Una mirada al trabajo que hay detrás de los modelos, con recomendaciones para quienes quieren dedicarse a este campo.
segments.en: Pablo Samuel Castro shares his experience as a research software developer at Google at the time of this interview. He discusses how he got into AI, the projects he has contributed to and the challenges of applied research. A look at the work behind the models, with advice for people considering a career in the field.
